body:
## Status: FILE ONLY / UNROUTED
Guy authorized redesign scoping and issue filing, not dispatch, implementation, fleet resume, PR, merge or release. No labels or assignees. Visual implementation requires approved prototype evidence and separate routing approval.

## Preserved contract
Accepted V1 panorama + R2 ranch environment + original V1 horse design and corrected grazing anatomy. Native procedural SwiftUI Canvas/Path with distinct/exportable layers; no flattened raster scene, video backdrop, WebView, new engine or service dependency. Same authoritative live model, filters, composite identities, blocked rail and Recent Output destination. Preserve truthful offline/unknown states and accessible operation. Day/Night/Auto environment remains independent of the app's Catppuccin preference. No daemon, SSE, pairing, grant, APNs or release work.

## Design dependency
Refs #455 — owner-selected contract and visual gate. Depends on approved prototype/spec, plus explicit routing. Refs #442/#444; do not duplicate gait #448 or repository ordering #449.

## Small scope
Own layout/composition only: FleetViews.swift Herd branch and mode-specific navigation shell; HerdView.swift root, summary, front-rail spacing and paddock navigation. Move the ranch background behind the entire Herd surface and safe areas. Overlay top scope + Settings and compact bottom paddock navigation; preserve the operational Board layout. Consume the approved visual control treatment, do not redesign filter logic or implement ambient motion here.

## Source
https://github.com/jirathip-dev/corral/blob/86d1287a9e5c611ec6bef677c95544c53e71b982/ios/FleetNotifier/UI/FleetViews.swift#L788-L805
https://github.com/jirathip-dev/corral/blob/86d1287a9e5c611ec6bef677c95544c53e71b982/ios/FleetNotifier/UI/Herd/HerdView.swift#L68-L90

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Full-screen Day/Night ranch behind top/bottom safe areas with no separate opaque Board-style header or duplicated toolbar in Herd.
- [ ] Top scope + Settings and bottom Previous/Next/paddock position are reachable at >=44pt targets, including small phones and accessibility Dynamic Type; no notch/home-indicator overlap.
- [ ] Preserve global blocked rail, truthful scoped counts, stale/offline/retry/Open Board recovery, long repository names and empty scope.
- [ ] Filters/selection/paddock identity and Recent Output routing survive layout and Board/Herd changes; no network restart or data-model fork.
- [ ] Background layers do not steal hit tests or deform approved horses/environment through uncontrolled aspect stretching.
- [ ] Actual native Day/Night images show entire screen including system chrome; physical iPhone evidence required for final full-screen/contrast claims. Test real control reachability and applicable native/CI gates, not source strings alone.

## Integration boundary
Coordinate toolbar removal with the saved-mode child; one owner for shared FleetViews.swift shell edits at a time. Filter-sheet styling is a separate child. Do not include a broad FleetViews refactor.
title: Herd: extend the ranch full-screen with floating top HUD and bottom paddock controls
